goal: Prod can read 100k logged-in Instagram pages a day: healthy accounts times a per-account rate proven over 2 full UTC days with 0 Instagram verdicts. Instagram kills at most 2% of prod accounts outside the canary in a day and at most 3 canary accounts an hour, and 99% of logged-in walks back 365 days reach the end. About 10% of accounts run as the canary, and staging keeps reading as a test bed.

metrics.label: Pages prod can read a day (healthy accounts times the safe rate)
Prod accounts outside the canary that Instagram killed in 24 h
Canary accounts that Instagram killed in the last 60 min
Logged-in walks back 365 days that reached the end, last 24 h

onMiss: For each missed metric, start or steer one live fix job with a board step under p1 whose text starts "d1/<metric key>:" naming the cause with the flags' numbers. A live job that owns the cause (await agent_observe.list_agents()) gets the numbers by message; else start one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd=...), set the step's job to it, never a second copy. Its brief names metric, value, target and cause and asks for shipped code until green. The capacity line names healthy accounts, proven rate, accounts needed; the canary job (p75) raises the rate. Slack DM the owner only when accounts on hand times the rate miss 100k; never buy accounts. An Instagram death drops that arm's cap and writes its codes. Deep walks: fix the error stops named. source_error: fix that read. canary_short and staging_stall go to their jobs. Prod promotes need no ask (c74); nothing goes outside (c37). Never end a run with a miss and no live fix job. All on target: end the turn with no message.
